title: Snapshot failed
description: board-host to board page: no Snapshot was written for the request with this ID (FR-26, AD-12). write-failed: the Snapshot folder could not be prepared or written, and folder names it; no-project-root: the session has no project root, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so no folder stands in for it; internal-error: AskBoard failed to make the Snapshot for another cause, such as a damaged view build; discarded: the ask is discarded. Only write-failed names a folder.
